about: LEONIDA_* switches the executable selects by its Direct3D adapter; this catalog is embedded at build time.
Every profile whose match fits the PC's card is applied, in this order; a later one overrides an earlier one.
match: vendor (nvidia, amd, intel, other), min_vram_mb, max_vram_mb, name (a wildcard on the card's name); empty matches every card.
opt_in: true: never applied by its match, only when [graphics].profiles or LEONIDA_PROFILE names it.
A value of null cancels an earlier profile value. Explicit environment values override TOML graphics settings, which override profiles.
Add a profile only with a measurement: the card, the CPU, the scene and the frame times before and after.
Your own changes go in gpu-profiles.local.json beside the selected config (current folder without one); same form, applied after this catalog; git ignores it.

LEONIDA_PROFILE=<name>[,<name>...] overrides [graphics].profiles: base and those profiles whatever the card; none disables profiles while keeping explicit settings. The existing value 1 is reserved for the diagnostics CPU sampler.

profiles.name: base
profiles.measured: victory-gta6 on an RTX 4070 (docs/fork-notes.md); kept on an RTX 3080 12 GB with a Ryzen 7 7800X3D, 2026-11-26

profiles.name: nvidia-code-tables
profiles.measured: RTX 5090, i9-14900KS, NVIDIA 580.173.02, Pop!_OS, Proton 11.0 and vkd3d-proton 3.2.0, 2026-11-26: six refused compute pipelines went from 0/6 to 6/6 created in a compile-only comparison. No frame-rate improvement is claimed. See docs/fork-notes.md, large code-literal tables on NVIDIA.

profiles.name: card-windows
profiles.measured: RTX 3080 12 GB, Ryzen 7 7800X3D, first rooms, 2026-11-26: usual frame 169-173 -> 149-158 ms, card time 103 -> 88 ms; but the windows take about 3.7 GB of the card and textures picked by index wait for room (host copies of textures 12,142 -> about 6,500): textures stay black. Opt-in until that is solved.

profiles.name: texture-keep
profiles.measured: RTX 3080 12 GB, Ryzen 7 7800X3D, driver 621.24, first rooms, two pairs of unattended runs, 2026-11-26: usual frame 156.5 -> 142 and 145 -> 130.5 ms; host copies of textures made again 14,986 -> 8,545 and 17,149 -> 5,674; but passes that made none for lack of room 96 -> 319 and 12 -> 390. Opt-in until measured on more cards.

profiles.name: readback-order
profiles.measured: Correctness only: a one-texel D3D12 regression (docs/fork-notes.md) copies 37 instead of 0 in LEONIDA_RELAY=0/1/2 on an RTX 5090. No frame times yet: opt-in until a scripts/measure-run.ps1 pair shows no cost.
